target.body:
Closes #98521

## What Problem This Solves

Operators currently have to correlate transient runtime output, session transcripts, and task records to answer who ran an agent or tool, what action occurred, when it happened, and how it ended. There is no single durable, bounded, redaction-safe query surface for those operational questions.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds a typed metadata-only audit contract over the existing agent-run and tool lifecycle signals. Events use stable identities and database order, carry agent/session/actor provenance and closed result/error codes, and persist through one Kysely-backed table in the shared state database. The implementation reuses current lifecycle and transcript ownership rather than creating another conversation store.

The operator surfaces are the read-authorized `audit.list` Gateway method and `openclaw audit`, including bounded filters, cursor pagination, and bounded JSON output. Prompts, message bodies, tool arguments, tool results, and raw error text are excluded by contract.

## User Impact

Authorized operators can inspect recent agent-run and tool-action history by agent, session, actor, action, status, and time range. Records survive process restarts, retain deterministic ordering, and are capped by a 30-day retention window, a 100,000-row limit, and 500-row query pages.

## Evidence

- Focused local behavior proof (324 tests):
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/audit/audit-events.test.ts src/audit/audit-event-writer.test.ts src/commands/audit.test.ts src/gateway/server-methods/audit.test.ts packages/gateway-protocol/src/schema/audit.test.ts src/infra/agent-events.test.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.test.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/side-question.test.ts src/agents/cli-runner.spawn.test.ts src/agents/command/attempt-execution.error-propagation.test.ts src/agents/cli-runner/execute.supervisor-capture.test.ts`
- Post-review regression proof:
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/command/attempt-execution.error-propagation.test.ts src/commands/agent.acp.test.ts src/commands/agent.test.ts`
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/audit/audit-events.test.ts src/audit/audit-event-writer.test.ts src/gateway/server-methods/audit.test.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/side-question.test.ts src/agents/cli-runner/execute.supervisor-capture.test.ts`
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/acp/control-plane/manager.test.ts src/agents/command/attempt-execution.error-propagation.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/dispatch-acp.test.ts`
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/acp/control-plane/manager.turn-results.test.ts src/agents/command/attempt-execution.error-propagation.test.ts src/agents/agent-command.live-model-switch.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply/dispatch-acp.test.ts`
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.test.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/side-question.test.ts`
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/event-projector.test.ts`
- Generated surfaces verified clean:
  - `node --import tsx scripts/protocol-gen.ts`
  - `node --import tsx scripts/protocol-gen-swift.ts`
  - `node scripts/generate-kysely-types.mjs`
  - `node scripts/generate-docs-map.mjs --check`
- Documentation checks:
  - `node scripts/format-docs.mjs --check`
  - `node scripts/check-docs-mdx.mjs docs README.md`
  - `node scripts/check-docs-i18n-glossary.mjs`
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwf5ws6pfwj2tcsavsnc54hn`: full `check:changed` lane passed, including all-project typecheck, core/extension/script lint, database-first guard, and runtime import cycles ([run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28530060815)). The wrapper stopped the successful one-shot session, so the backing lifecycle job may display as cancelled after the command completed with exit 0.
- Blacksmith Testbox `tbx_01kwf7yk3968m7vh2634qabet9`: a real Gateway agent turn invoked one `exec` tool action, then `openclaw audit --json` returned four ordered metadata-only records ([run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28532183950)). The same run seeded the shared database from the pre-feature schema, preserved an existing row, added `audit_events` on open, proved a one-record page has a next cursor, and verified prompt/reply/tool-result sentinels plus unexpected fields were absent. Command and wrapper both exited 0; provider-owned one-shot cleanup may display the backing lifecycle job as cancelled.

  ```json
  {
    "gatewayHealth": "ok",
    "upgrade": { "existingStatePreserved": true, "auditTableAdded": true, "auditRows": 4 },
    "page": { "limit": 1, "eventCount": 1, "hasNextCursor": true },
    "redaction": { "contract": "metadata_only", "contentSentinelsAbsent": true, "unexpectedFieldsAbsent": true },
    "events": [
      { "sequence": 4, "kind": "agent_run", "action": "agent.run.finished", "status": "succeeded" },
      { "sequence": 3, "kind": "tool_action", "action": "tool.action.finished", "status": "succeeded", "toolName": "exec" },
      { "sequence": 2, "kind": "tool_action", "action": "tool.action.started", "status": "started", "toolName": "exec" },
      { "sequence": 1, "kind": "agent_run", "action": "agent.run.started", "status": "started" }
    ]
  }
  ```

- Fresh `koffing-updated` xhigh review against `origin/main`: clean, no accepted or actionable findings.
- Exact head `320e277fc6b354eae689496fbdd265a18b784380`: no pending or failing checks after the initial workflow run; scope and draft admission skipped the remaining checks, and GitHub reports no required checks configured.

## Risks and Non-Goals

- No Control UI is included; this PR provides the protocol and operator read foundation only.
- No new broad configuration surface is added. Retention and queue bounds are fixed safety limits for this foundation.
- No prompt, content, argument, result, or raw-error capture is added, and existing transcript files remain the only conversation artifacts.
- Draft PR #98510 overlaps only the generated `apps/shared/OpenClawKit/Sources/OpenClawProtocol/GatewayModels.swift` protocol output. There is no runtime dependency, but whichever branch merges second will need to regenerate that additive shared file.

## AI Disclosure

AI-assisted implementation and review. Maintainer review remains required; no agent transcript is attached.
